q1: SELECT name FROM drinker WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT f.bar FROM frequents AS f, serves AS s WHERE f.drinker = drinker.name AND f.bar = s.bar AND NOT s.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM likes WHERE drinker = drinker.name))
q2: WITH innie AS (SELECT Serves.bar, Serves.beer, Likes.drinker FROM Serves JOIN Likes ON Serves.beer = Likes.beer JOIN Frequents ON Likes.drinker = Frequents.drinker WHERE Serves.bar = Frequents.bar ORDER BY Serves.bar), otherBeers AS (SELECT Serves.bar, Serves.beer, Frequents.drinker FROM Frequents JOIN Serves ON Serves.bar = Frequents.bar ORDER BY Frequents.drinker) SELECT drinker FROM (SELECT * FROM otherBeers) AS pickyDrinkers
